messages:
morgan: Heads-up — external pen-test vendor booked a live-fire window on Wed 09:00-11:00 UTC for infra + KMS flow. I just realized Dedicated GPU maintenance overlap 09:30-10:30 that will evict running pods. Can we re-evaluate?

tara: oh no. which Dedicated pool? the south-prod-gpu one? :eyes:

morgan: yes south-prod-gpu (reserved capacity for customers). Vendor wants staging->canary->prod walk, includes KMS access and agent-run scenarios.

sam: eviction during live-fire = bad. can we shift to a read-only scenario for that hour and postpone prod phase?

ev an: (note: sam wrote) — we can flip maintenance to after 12:00 but that requires approving oncall rotation changes.

jess: also we need to confirm assessor creds: ephemeral roles + presigned evidence upload path. assessor asked for S3 presigned URL TTL 8h. Is that ok for compliance?

security-oncall: short answer: TTL 8h is fine if we tie it to an ephemeral role and ensure CloudTrail shows the upload event. Need KMS envelope keys used for artifact encryption.

morgan: vendor will run automated exploit chains against model-serving and log ingestion. We need to ensure audit logging is enabled for the KV cache service and the embedding pipeline. Where are the log retention proofs?

tara: retention proofs are in the evidence bucket, path: `s3://redwood-evidence/pt-2026/retention-manifest.json` and in docs https://internal.redwood/docs/pt-evidence-retention (internal).

sam: quick ask for infra: can SRE put the south-prod-gpu maintenance into a maintenance window that excludes eviction (cordon + drain of only non-critical nodes)? Or we move the maintenance to 12:30-13:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance request submitted: id=mt-8421, proposed window=2026-03-11T12:30:00Z-13:30:00Z. (runbook: https://ci.redwood/runbooks/mt-8421)

ev an: +1 on moving maintenance. Oncall, can you sign off?

security-oncall: I can sign off if we do the following: 1) freeze prod phase of pen-test to a canary-only scope, 2) generate ephemeral roles for assessor with least privilege, 3) ensure KMS audit logs are forwarded to SIEM and not truncated during the retention window.

jess: for ephemeral roles: create role `assessor/pt-2026` with policy limiting actions to `kms:Decrypt` only for the evidence wrapper and `s3:PutObject` on the evidence bucket prefix. Use session tags `assessor:vendor=alpha`.

morgan: I'll create the SEC ticket and assign owners. Quick draft: SEC-8421 Pen-test window collision + evidence & ephemeral creds. Owner=morgan, SRE=sam, Assessor creds=jess, Compliance=tara.

sam: re: audit logs, here's a quick command to confirm KMS audit events in CloudTrail for a given window:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-03-11T08:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-11T14:00:00Z
```

jess: also add a log-sampling hook on the embedding service so we capture pre/post inference traces (not full payloads). We should redact PII.

morgan: vendor asked about retest cadence. Proposed plan: initial test Wed 09:00-11:00 UTC but with prod phase removed. Retest (full walk) can happen Thu 09:00-11:00 UTC after maintenance moved. Is that acceptable?

security-oncall: acceptable. Make sure we document rollback and emergency stop: runbook link and oncall roster. Also ensure alert routing to #incidents if escalations > sev2.

jess: created role and policy draft in `infra/iam/playbooks/assessor-ephemeral.json` — pinging for review.

sam: I'll update maintenance window to 12:30, confirm with infra-oncall, and add node exclusion flag to avoid evicting reserved pools.

morgan: thanks. action items: 1) morgan create SEC-8421 + evidence manifest link; 2) jess create ephemeral role + attach policy; 3) sam update maintenance window + node exclusion; 4) security-oncall confirm SIEM log forwarding; 5) vendor to accept revised plan and retest slot Thu 09-11.

security-oncall: signed off. please post final runbook URL here once all done. :thumbsup:

morgan: will do. cc @vendor-alpha (vendor contact) — please confirm Thu retest or propose alternate.

vendor-alpha: confirmed Thu 09:00-11:00 UTC works for us. we'll skip prod phase on Wed and only run canary/staging. we'll hand over evidence upload via presigned URL (TTL 8h).

morgan: closing thread when SEC-8421 ticket is open. thanks all.
